wikipedia.title: A. Timmasagar
wikipedia.text: A. Timmasagar is a village in the southern state of Karnataka, India. It is located in the Hubli taluk of Dharwad district in Karnataka.

wikipedia.title: Hubli-Dharwad Central Assembly constituency
wikipedia.text:
Hubli-Dharwad Central Assembly constituency is one of the 224 Legislative Assembly constituencies of Karnataka in India.
It is a part of Dharwad district and Dharwad Lok Sabha constituency.

wikipedia.title: Hubli Rural Assembly constituency
wikipedia.text: Hubli Rural Assembly constituency was one of the 224 Vidhan Sabha constituencies in Karnataka Legislative Assembly that used to come under Dharwad district and it came into existence in 1972 and was abolished after the 2008 delimitation exercise. This seat was once held by 2 Chief Ministers S. R. Bommai and Jagadish Shettar and former Chief Minister Basavaraj Bommai contested in this constituency once in 1994 but lost to Jagadish Shettar.

wikivoyage.title: Hubli
wikivoyage.text:
Hubli, officially known as Hubballi, is a city in Northwestern Karnataka. The city is a bustling trading centre of little scenic beauty.


== See ==
Venkateshwara temple behind Nrupatunga Betta (hill) for calm and serenity. 5 km from Chennamma Circle.
Gayatri Tapovan- near Tadasa, 21 km on Bengaluru Road,
Water Park 9 km from Chennamma Circle on Karwar Road.
1 Unkal Lake and Bund Garden (4 km from Hubli on Dharwad Road.).  
2 Chandramauleshwara Temple. 11th-century Shiva temple. (updated Dec 2022)
3 Banashankari Temple.  (updated Dec 2022)
4 Nrupatunga Betta (5 km from chennamma circle.). promising panoramic view of the expanse of Hubli City- with in city, (updated Feb 2026)
5 Indira Gandhi Glass House, Sadashiva Nagar (walking distance from Chennamma circle).  (updated Feb 2026)
6 Siddharodh Math, 3 km from Chennamma Circle on Karwar road.  (updated Feb 2026)
7 Eshwar Temple, Siddharooda Matt Road, Srinivas Nagar, Old Hubli.  (updated Feb 2026)


== Do ==


== Eat ==
Jowar Rotti
Badanikai Palya
Red Chilli Chutney
 Biryani Paradise, Unkal Cross.  
Ground Nut Powder etc.
New Bombay Hotel, Old Hubli
Chat
Smoking Joes Pizzas
Good North Indian and South Indian restaurants are in plenty
Do visit the local khanavalis (Kannada name of "hotel") which provide authentic North Karnataka food, they are plenty and aptly priced around ₹30 to ₹50 per meals.
Seven Beans: a superb cafe located at Vidyanagar, Hubli. Visit to see the local youngsters congregating and for some great coffees! Also provides free unlimited WI-FI, a library, business solutions etc.

 Canara Hotel, Hosur. One of the best hotels for delicious South and North Indian delicacy 
 The Hans Hotel, PB Road, Vidyanagar (Opp BVB College), ☏ +91 8362374771. Authentic cuisines of Indian, Continental and Chinese. Also, a great lounge bar. 
 Al Taj, Near Jain Temple Keshwapur. 1100-2300. Great Non Veg Food. (updated Jan 2022)


== Drink ==
Lassi
Butter milk
The juice shop opposite Janata Bazar sells delicious juices
The juice of sugar cane  all season you can drink in all over hubli or dharwar,
 Abhiman hotel, Opp kims main gate (Vidhyanagar). Onion chicken, natti chicken, neer dosa, boiled shenga ,g p dry, ring pakoda 
 Nirmila Kitchen, Ashok Nagar (Near old railway gate), ☏ +91 9663860907. Specialist in North Indian Thalis and Prathas 
1 OMG Lounge, Poolside at The Hans Hotel, ☏ +91 8362374772. 3:30-11:30PM. An intimate & fashionable lounge bar. It combines international standards with a touch of Indian warmth and hospitality & presents a distinctive dining experience.
